description:
`mesh.flag_cells`: store the cells that fail (or warn) a quality profile as a cell set.

A cell is flagged if any selected metric grades at or above `level`, or if it is invalid
(`include_invalid`). The set is a `MeshSet` of cells named `name`, stored in the mesh so
later ops can target it by id. An empty selection succeeds with a `diag.nothing_to_flag`
warning and no set. A name already used in the mesh is an error. `thresholds` override the
limits as in `mesh.quality`; `grow` adds rings of face neighbours (deterministic BFS).

grow.description: Add this many rings of face neighbours to the set, 0 to 5 (default 0).

include_invalid.description: Also flag inverted and degenerate cells (default true).

level.description: `fail` (default) flags failing cells, `warn` also warning cells.

mesh.description: The mesh; defaults to the only mesh of the state.

metrics.description: Metric names to grade instead of the profile's rules.

name.description: Name of the set: 1 to 64 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]`, unused in the mesh.

thresholds.description: Limit overrides by metric name, as in `mesh.quality`.
